title: Micciancio-Peikert Prime-Power Search-to-Decision Adapter, Hensel Subgroup Probes, and Sample Expansion Audit

scope.hensel_subgroup_probe: At level l in [0, r-1], probing a' = a + u*3^(r-1-l)*e_j and y' = y - <a, s_low> + u*3^(r-1)*d + e_widen mod 3^r preserves the error law iff d == s_upper_j mod 3 and shifts by the full order-3 subgroup {0, 3^(r-1), 2*3^(r-1)} when d != s_upper_j mod 3
scope.false_prefix_propagation: If s_low != s mod 3^l, none of the 3 candidate digits d in {0, 1, 2} cancels the u-dependent shift
scope.coupled_widening_and_sample_expansion: Combines rounded-input widening TV loss, certified adaptive-threshold dither sampler loss, and 2*n*r*R_rep*m_dec disjoint sample expansion
